Whitehead, and then came George Chantler, with Bert Smith and Mick Porter also in the first fifty men home. We finished 4th in the team race, which was won by Woodford Green A.C., with Mitcham A.C. second and Blackheath third.

Robertson, the Reading International runner, and with Bert Smith and Dick Tobin coming in behind one another in 7th and 8th places, we won the team race with individuals deleted by scoring 12 pts. to Portsmouth's 20 and T.V.H. 23.
